_comment: Realistic happy-path incident case for the incident-management worked example. Drives the cross-target replay test under tests/examples/test_incident_management_happy_path.py. Inputs are pinned so the canonical case-state JSON every target produces is deterministic byte-for-byte across replays. LM-touching steps (free-text fields on the final-report submission, DSPy signature in primitives/signatures.py) are out of scope here — this fixture exercises the CORE-bound deterministic primitives only: classification (significance + cross-border), the three-stage NIS2 Article 23 clock, the fail-closed regulator-destination resolver, and the F-PT-02 incident-timeline binding adapter.
